node.statement: Amplified formula and range. By lem-compcb-amplified-compression, id_{M_n} tensor Co_P=Co_{P_n} and M_n tensor S_P=S_{P_n}, where P_n=I_n tensor P. Therefore T_n(x)=Co_{P_n}(v_n(x)) for x in M_n tensor J and lies in Image(Co_{P_n})=S_{P_n}=M_n tensor S_P. Both v_n and Co_{P_n} are linear by def-extended-delta-inclusion and def-compressed-corner, so T_n is linear.
